Separately, the reagent supply contract is worth $46,000, and it sits alongside the other purchasing and logistics activity described in the latest updates. The figure of $175,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The facilities works is scheduled to end on Tuesday 4 May 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. That schedule matters for the equipment side of the project, since the facilities handover sets the starting point for the next phase of work. A delayed biosafety permit could delay the first production sequencing run.

Instrument installation can begin 10 working days after the facilities works ends. The vendor training week is on Monday 11 October 2027, and the validation run is on Wednesday 6 October 2027. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

The first production sequencing run is planned for Thursday 8 July 2027. The funder site visit is on Thursday 25 February 2027, and it is the earliest of the external events mentioned in the correspondence so far. Project leads have been referring to these entries when coordinating their own workstream plans. Late delivery of the freezer units could delay the first production sequencing run.

On capacity, the plan provides for 76 sequencing runs per month. An additional 12 sequencing runs per month were approved in March. The updates present the two statements as they were recorded, and they do not give a combined monthly figure.

briefing:
The Lumen Ridge relocation now has its official opening set for Monday 8 November 2027, according to the revised plan of Thursday 21 January 2027. That plan supersedes all earlier emails, including the email of Friday 15 January 2027 that gave the official opening as Tuesday 24 August 2027. The approved project budget is £303,000, and the steering group approved an increase of £6,000 to it in March. A proposed further increase of £28,000 was rejected by the steering group. A dispute over the lift installation could delay the official opening of the new office. The figure of £303,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Ownership of the workstreams is settled. Rafael Marchetti owns the network cabling workstream, and the installation is scheduled to end on Friday 2 April 2027. Anders Valdés owns the lease negotiation workstream, with Emeka Kowalczyk supporting it and attending its meetings. Tomasz Fontaine owns moving logistics, and Leilani Petrov owns the security badges workstream. A delay in fire-safety certification could delay the official opening of the new office.

Furniture procurement is owned by Lucía Nakamura, and Mei Iyer supports the workstream and attends its meetings. The furniture supplier contract is worth £11,000. The plan provides for 200 desks, and an additional 36 desks were approved in March. A request for 9 more desks is still awaiting approval.

On sequencing, the staff move-in can begin 8 working days after the network cabling installation ends. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. The staff communications kickoff, planned for Friday 13 August 2027, can begin 3 working days after the network cabling sign-off is completed. A shortage of parking spaces could affect the number of desks. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Several reviews and checkpoints are scheduled. The moving logistics checkpoint is on Thursday 11 February 2027, and the security badges review follows on Wednesday 10 March 2027. The budget review is on Tuesday 7 September 2027, after the staff communications kickoff. Rising removal costs could affect the budget.

Later events include the all-staff briefing on Friday 30 July 2027 and the landlord walkthrough on Friday 29 October 2027. The landlord walkthrough comes ahead of the official opening on Monday 8 November 2027.

**Memo to Bastian Szabo, Programme Director**

**Summary**

The Lumen Ridge relocation official opening is now Monday 8 November 2027, under the revised plan of Thursday 21 January 2027, which supersedes all earlier emails. Two risks could delay the opening: a dispute over the lift installation, and a delay in fire-safety certification.

**Key facts**

- Furniture procurement is owned by Lucía Nakamura.
- The furniture supplier contract is worth £11,000.
- Anders Valdés owns the lease negotiation workstream.
- The project budget after all approved changes is £309,000. This is the £303,000 first approved plus the £6,000 increase approved in March. The further £28,000 increase proposed was rejected.
- The security badges review (Wednesday 10 March 2027) takes place 19 working days after the moving logistics checkpoint (Thursday 11 February 2027).
- The budget review is on Tuesday 7 September 2027.

**Next steps**

Dated items and dependencies from the briefing:

- Network cabling installation ends Friday 2 April 2027. The staff move-in can begin 8 working days later, so the earliest date is Wednesday 14 April 2027.
- The staff communications kickoff is planned for Friday 13 August 2027. It can begin 3 working days after network cabling sign-off, so the latest sign-off date for it to go ahead as planned is Tuesday 10 August 2027.
- The all-staff briefing is on Friday 30 July 2027.
- The budget review follows on Tuesday 7 September 2027.
- The landlord walkthrough is on Friday 29 October 2027, ahead of the official opening on Monday 8 November 2027.

briefing:
The Pellucid classroom technology refresh is organised into five workstreams, each with a named owner. Corentin Esposito owns the network upgrade, Noor Iyer owns device procurement, and Kwame Haddad owns asset tagging. Yuki Bakshi owns teacher training, and Anders Novak owns the safeguarding filters. Device breakage rates could affect the budget.

On the network side, the upgrade is scheduled to end on Monday 22 March 2027. The project works to a Monday to Friday week, and there are no public holidays in this period. A shortage of charging trolleys could delay the first lessons on the new devices.

Device deployment can begin 3 working days after the network upgrade ends. That rule is the basis for scheduling the handover of equipment to classrooms, and the asset tagging and procurement workstreams are expected to line up their own activity with it. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

On the financial side, the approved project budget is £526,000. The steering group approved an increase of £9,000 to the project budget in March. The device leasing agreement is worth £27,000, and it sits within the wider programme of spending on equipment. Rising support fees could affect the number of laptops. The figure of £526,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

For equipment numbers, the plan provides for 123 laptops. An additional 8 laptops were approved in March, in the same month as the budget increase.

Several fixed dates shape the calendar for the second half of the project. The governors' meeting is on Friday 26 February 2027, which comes before the network upgrade is due to finish. The teacher training day is on Wednesday 16 June 2027, and the parents' evening follows on Monday 5 July 2027. The first lessons on the new devices are planned for Friday 5 November 2027.

I have compiled these points from the latest status updates and emails, and the workstream owners remain the first contact for detail on their own areas. Late approval of the content filter could delay the first lessons on the new devices.

reference:
**Memo to Idris Mwangi, Programme Director**

**Summary**

The conference opening day is now Wednesday 14 April 2027, under the revised plan of Wednesday 27 January 2027, which supersedes all earlier emails. Late venue licensing and the keynote speaker's visa delay could each delay it. The project budget after approved changes is £283,000.

**Key facts**

- **Conference opening day:** Wednesday 14 April 2027.
- **Project budget:** £283,000, which is £301,000 as first approved less the approved £18,000 reduction. The proposed £53,000 increase was rejected.
- **Speaker programme workstream:** owned by Anders Whitfield.
- **Audio-visual production workstream:** owned by Lucía Castellanos. The contract is worth £28,500.
- **Risks to the opening day:** late venue licensing and the keynote speaker's visa delay.
- **Ticket sales:** the earliest start is Monday 15 February 2027, which is 8 working days after venue contract signature ends on Wednesday 3 February 2027.
- **Registration sign-off:** to keep the catering kickoff on its planned date of Tuesday 16 March 2027, it must be completed by Thursday 4 March 2027 at the latest.
- **Catering tasting:** Wednesday 17 November 2027.
- **Venue booking review:** Thursday 23 September 2027, which is 6 working days after the sponsorship checkpoint on Wednesday 15 September 2027.

**Next steps**

- Venue contract signature is scheduled to end on Wednesday 3 February 2027, and ticket sales can begin 8 working days after that.
- Registration sign-off must be completed by Thursday 4 March 2027 for the catering kickoff to go ahead on Tuesday 16 March 2027.
- The conference opening day is Wednesday 14 April 2027, followed by registration desk training on Wednesday 21 April 2027 and the speaker briefing on Wednesday 30 June 2027.
- The sponsorship checkpoint is on Wednesday 15 September 2027, followed by the venue booking review on Thursday 23 September 2027.
- The catering tasting is on Wednesday 17 November 2027.

briefing:
The Fernhollow classroom technology refresh is organised into five workstreams, each with a named owner. Rafael Abernethy owns the network upgrade, Idris Mwangi owns device procurement, and Anders Castellanos owns asset tagging. Emeka Okafor is responsible for the safeguarding filters workstream, while Mei Szabo leads teacher training.

On budget, the approved project budget is £530,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of £44,000 to the project budget. The device leasing agreement is worth £37,500. These figures are reported as they appear in the latest updates, and no further adjustments have been made in this briefing. Rising support fees could affect the number of laptops. The figure of £530,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The plan provides for 331 laptops. In March, an additional 36 laptops were approved. Procurement updates from Idris Mwangi's workstream have not changed those entries, and the two figures are noted here as they were recorded.

The network upgrade is scheduled to end on Wednesday 2 June 2027. Rafael Abernethy's updates continue to use that date as the reference point for the workstream. A shortage of charging trolleys could delay the first lessons on the new devices.

Device deployment can begin 5 working days after the network upgrade ends. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. The first lessons on the new devices are planned for Wednesday 14 July 2027, which is the point at which the refresh becomes visible to pupils in classrooms. Delays in the wireless survey could delay the first lessons on the new devices. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Several events are fixed in the calendar. The safeguarding review is on Friday 14 May 2027, and the teacher training day follows on Monday 17 May 2027. Emeka Okafor and Mei Szabo are each linked to one of those events through their workstreams. The supplier demo is on Monday 22 November 2027. Device breakage rates could affect the budget.

The Veridian sequencing lab setup is being coordinated through five workstreams, each with a named owner. Dmitri Takahashi owns the facilities works workstream, Thandiwe Brennan owns instrument purchasing, and Priya Marchetti owns biosafety approval. Mei Halloran owns LIMS configuration, and Emeka Abernethy owns cold-chain logistics. Lower sample volumes than forecast could affect the number of sequencing runs per month.

On the budget, the approved project budget is $234,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of $12,000 to the project budget. Separately, the reagent supply contract is worth $22,500. These figures are reported here as they appear in the status updates, without further reconciliation. Late delivery of the freezer units could delay the first production sequencing run. The figure of $234,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The facilities works is scheduled to end on Friday 30 April 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. reference:
**Memo to Freya Valdés, Programme Director**
**Subject: Veridian office relocation – status briefing**

**Summary**

The official opening of the new office is now Friday 6 August 2027. The revised plan of Friday 15 January 2027 set this date and supersedes all earlier emails, including the one of Tuesday 5 January 2027. Two risks could delay the opening: late delivery of the server racks, and a dispute over the lift installation.

**Key facts**

- **Delay risks:** Late delivery of the server racks and a dispute over the lift installation could each delay the official opening.
- **Furniture supplier contract:** £27,500.
- **Furniture delivery:** Friday 9 April 2027.
- **Network cabling owner:** Marisol Oyelaran.
- **Lease negotiation owner:** Oluwaseun Fontaine.
- **Moving logistics review:** It takes place 7 working days after the staff communications checkpoint (Tuesday 20 July 2027 to Thursday 29 July 2027).
- **Project budget after all approved changes:** £509,000. This is the £518,000 first approved, less the £9,000 reduction approved in March. The proposed further increase of £27,000 was rejected.
- **Earliest staff move-in:** Friday 18 June 2027, which is 5 working days after the network cabling installation ends on Friday 11 June 2027.
- **Latest furniture procurement sign-off:** Wednesday 29 September 2027. The security badges kickoff can begin 5 working days after that sign-off, and it is planned for Wednesday 6 October 2027.

**Next steps**

The dated items and dependencies in the briefing are:

- Furniture delivery on Friday 9 April 2027.
- Landlord walkthrough on Friday 23 April 2027.
- Security audit on Tuesday 11 May 2027.
- Network cabling installation ends on Friday 11 June 2027, and staff move-in can begin 5 working days later.

briefing:
The Halvorsen warehouse automation is organised around several workstreams, each with a named owner. Hamid Iyer owns robot procurement, while Ingrid Quiroga owns the floor reinforcement workstream. Freya Kowalczyk owns safety training, Zainab Okafor owns shift planning, and Aisling Halloran owns maintenance contracts. The maintenance contract is worth €19,000. Late delivery of charging stations could delay the switch to automated picking.

On the equipment side, the plan provides for 16 picking robots. In March the steering group approved an increase of €48,000 to the project budget, and an additional 2 picking robots were approved in March as well. The approved project budget is €81,000. The quarterly budget review is on Wednesday 10 March 2027, and the insurance assessment follows on Tuesday 30 March 2027. The figure of €81,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The floor reinforcement work is scheduled to end on Wednesday 30 June 2027. The supplier factory visit is on Thursday 15 July 2027, and it sits in the schedule alongside the installation preparations that Hamid Iyer's procurement workstream is handling. Spare-part price rises could affect the budget.

For the sequencing of the installation itself, robot installation can begin 8 working days after the floor reinforcement work ends. For this purpose, working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. That rule is stated here as it was given in the status updates, so the installation start follows from it directly. A failed load test on the mezzanine could delay the switch to automated picking. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Looking further ahead, the switch to automated picking is planned for Wednesday 20 October 2027. Zainab Okafor's shift planning and Freya Kowalczyk's safety training sit with that changeover, and Aisling Halloran's maintenance contracts workstream covers the contract noted above. Ingrid Quiroga's floor reinforcement work remains the stage that precedes installation.

That is the picture as it stands from the latest updates and emails. Further detail will follow from the workstream owners as their sections are updated. Higher electricity costs could affect the number of picking robots.

An unfilled lab manager post could delay the first production sequencing run. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

The figure of $200,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Looking further ahead, the validation run is on Wednesday 28 July 2027. The first production sequencing run is planned for Tuesday 17 August 2027. The vendor training week is on Tuesday 5 October 2027, and it is the last of the dated milestones listed in the updates gathered so far.

briefing:
The Orrin office relocation is being run through five named workstreams, each with a single owner. Hamid Nakamura owns the lease negotiation workstream, and Ingrid Szabo owns the moving logistics workstream. Dmitri Castellanos owns the network cabling workstream, Svetlana Oyelaran owns the security badges workstream, and Rohan Delacroix owns the staff communications workstream.

On budget, the approved project budget is £468,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of £42,000 to the project budget. The furniture supplier contract is worth £24,500, and it sits alongside the furniture delivery, which is on Thursday 13 May 2027. Late delivery of the server racks could delay the official opening of the new office. The figure of £468,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

On the layout, the plan provides for 73 desks. In March an additional 5 desks were approved as well. The briefing does not set out how these two figures relate beyond that, and the sources do not say anything further on the point. A delay in fire-safety certification could delay the official opening of the new office.

The security audit is on Wednesday 24 March 2027, which comes ahead of the furniture delivery. The network cabling installation is scheduled to end on Wednesday 26 May 2027, and that installation is the responsibility of Dmitri Castellanos and his workstream. Higher-than-expected furniture prices could affect the number of desks.

For the move itself, the staff move-in can begin 6 working days after the network cabling installation ends. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Ingrid Szabo's moving logistics workstream covers the arrangements for the move. A shortage of parking spaces could affect the budget. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Looking further ahead, the all-staff briefing is on Friday 6 August 2027, and Rohan Delacroix's staff communications workstream is the one connected to it. The official opening of the new office is planned for Friday 5 November 2027. Svetlana Oyelaran continues to own the security badges workstream, and Hamid Nakamura continues to own the lease negotiation workstream, as listed at the start of this briefing.

briefing:
The Corvane flagship store launch is being run through five workstreams, each with a named owner. Bastian Abernethy owns the shop fit-out workstream, Svetlana Petrov owns stock buying, Elif Iyer owns staff recruitment, Emeka Achterberg owns point-of-sale systems, and Rafael Esposito owns the marketing campaign. This briefing pulls together the latest status updates and email threads on each of them. Weaker footfall forecasts could affect the number of staff hires.

On the physical side, the shop fit-out is scheduled to end on Tuesday 25 May 2027. The shop-fitting contract is worth €38,500. The store opening is planned for Friday 16 July 2027, and the project team is working towards that date across all workstreams.

Stock buying follows from the fit-out schedule in one respect. Stock loading can begin 10 working days after the shop fit-out ends. For this purpose, working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Svetlana Petrov's workstream is therefore the one that connects most directly to the fit-out timetable. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

On staffing, the plan provides for 32 staff hires, and an additional 3 staff hires were approved in March. Elif Iyer is handling recruitment against those approvals. A staff training day is on Thursday 21 October 2027, and it sits within the same workstream area as the hiring effort. Higher rent from the service charge could affect the budget.

On the financial side, the approved project budget is €170,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of €49,000 to the project budget. Both figures are recorded here as they appear in the status updates, alongside the shop-fitting contract value mentioned above. Late delivery of the till system could delay the store opening. The figure of €170,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Several review and checkpoint events are also in the calendar. The marketing review is on Friday 30 July 2027, and Rafael Esposito's campaign work is the subject of that session. The stock count is on Monday 2 August 2027. Emeka Achterberg's point-of-sale systems workstream continues alongside these, with no separate milestone date recorded in the updates received so far. A shortfall in seasonal stock could delay the store opening.

reference:
**Memo to Priya Nakamura, Programme Director**

**Summary**

This memo sets out the key facts for the Fernhollow classroom technology refresh. The first lessons on the new devices are currently set for Tuesday 3 August 2027, under the revised plan of Tuesday 19 January 2027, which supersedes all earlier emails. Two risks could delay those lessons: delays in the wireless survey, and a shortage of charging trolleys.

**Key facts**

- Budget: The project budget after all approved changes is £429,000. This is the original £396,000 plus the £33,000 increase approved in March. The further £35,000 increase was rejected.
- Leasing: The device leasing agreement is worth £52,500.
- Safeguarding filters: Ingrid Esposito owns this workstream. The safeguarding review is on Tuesday 4 May 2027.
- Device procurement: Leilani Halloran owns this workstream.
- Parent communications: The review on Wednesday 24 February 2027 takes place 6 working days after the asset tagging checkpoint on Tuesday 16 February 2027.
- Device deployment: The network upgrade ends on Tuesday 9 March 2027. Deployment can begin 8 working days later, so the earliest date is Friday 19 March 2027.
- Teacher training kickoff: It is planned for Monday 20 September 2027 and can begin 4 working days after network upgrade sign-off. The latest sign-off date for it to go ahead as planned is Tuesday 14 September 2027.

**Next steps**

- Network upgrade ends Tuesday 9 March 2027, and device deployment can begin from Friday 19 March 2027.
- The safeguarding review takes place on Tuesday 4 May 2027.
- Network upgrade sign-off must be completed by Tuesday 14 September 2027 for the teacher training kickoff to go ahead on Monday 20 September 2027.
- The first lessons on the new devices are set for Tuesday 3 August 2027, subject to the wireless survey and charging trolley risks noted above.

briefing:
The Halvorsen annual partner conference is planned to open on Tuesday 28 September 2027. The approved project budget is £473,000, and the steering group approved a reduction of £53,000 to the project budget in March. The workstreams each have a named owner, and this briefing draws together the latest status updates and emails from them. The keynote speaker's visa delay could delay the conference opening day. The figure of £473,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Rohan Sørensen owns the venue booking workstream. Venue contract signature is scheduled to end on Thursday 10 June 2027. Ingrid Okafor owns the registration workstream, which is where the plan for delegate places sits: the plan provides for 586 delegate places, and an additional 61 delegate places were approved in March.

On timing for registration, ticket sales can begin 10 working days after venue contract signature ends. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Ingrid's team will need that start point for its own planning, and the briefing leaves the arithmetic to the registration workstream. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Hamid Nakamura owns the audio-visual production workstream. The audio-visual production contract is worth £84,000. The dress rehearsal is on Monday 14 June 2027, and the sponsor call is on Thursday 20 May 2027, so the sponsor conversation comes ahead of the rehearsal in the calendar. Low early registrations could affect the budget.

Joaquin Lindqvist owns the speaker programme workstream, and Anders Quiroga owns the catering workstream. The catering tasting is on Monday 18 October 2027, as recorded in the latest catering update. A clash with a rail strike could delay the conference opening day.

Further updates from each workstream owner will be added to this briefing as they arrive, with the budget, delegate place and contract figures kept as they appear in the source emails. Rising catering prices could affect the number of delegate places.

briefing:
The Quillon warehouse automation project is moving through its planned sequence of works, and this note pulls together the latest status updates and emails. The approved project budget is €206,000, and the steering group approved a reduction of €39,000 to the project budget in March. The plan provides for 33 picking robots, and an additional 5 picking robots were approved in March. Union consultation on shift patterns could affect the number of picking robots. The figure of €206,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Aisling Mwangi owns the floor reinforcement workstream, and the floor reinforcement work is scheduled to end on Thursday 13 May 2027. Rafael Raman owns the robot procurement workstream, which covers the picking robots mentioned above and sits alongside the physical preparation of the site. A failed load test on the mezzanine could delay the switch to automated picking.

Robot installation can begin 6 working days after the floor reinforcement work ends. For planning purposes, working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. The switch to automated picking is planned for Monday 14 June 2027, and that date is the reference point the other workstreams are building toward. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

On the people side, Priya Szabo owns the shift planning workstream, while Svetlana Haddad owns the safety training workstream. The operator training course is on Wednesday 25 August 2027, and the insurance assessment is on Monday 23 August 2027. Both fall within the same week and are recorded in the project calendar as separate items. Delayed customs clearance for the robots could delay the switch to automated picking.

Tomasz Valdés owns the maintenance contracts workstream. The maintenance contract is worth €49,000, and it is handled within that workstream rather than under procurement of the robots themselves.

Finally, the quarterly budget review is on Friday 12 November 2027. Financial figures quoted in this briefing are taken as they appear in the status updates and emails, and the review is the next formal point at which the budget position will be discussed by the group. Spare-part price rises could affect the budget.

Late fixes from the vendor could delay the go-live of the new CRM. The figure of $260,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The data migration is scheduled to end on Wednesday 17 March 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Those working-day rules apply to the sequencing that follows the migration.

User acceptance testing can begin 8 working days after the data migration ends. That sequencing sits alongside the other fixed points in the schedule, so the team has a clear reference for when testing becomes available. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

This briefing is compiled from the latest status updates and emails, and it records the position as currently stated in those sources. Further detail on individual workstreams will be added as the owners provide it. Overtime costs for the support team could affect the budget.

Amara Kaur is responsible for moving logistics, while Mei Raman leads staff communications. Zainab Esposito owns the security badges workstream.

On the furniture side, the supplier contract is worth £51,000, and the delivery is on Friday 19 February 2027. The plan provides for 223 desks, and an additional 28 desks were approved in March. The briefing records both figures as stated in the status updates, without any adjustment to the plan figure. A shortage of parking spaces could affect the number of desks.

Budget matters have a clear reference point. The approved project budget is £246,000, and the steering group approved a reduction of £56,000 to the project budget in March. The budget review is on Wednesday 24 February 2027, so that meeting is the next scheduled occasion for the finance position to be discussed. The updates do not say how the March reduction relates to the approved budget figure, and this briefing does not offer an interpretation. Late delivery of the server racks could delay the official opening of the new office. The figure of £246,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

The technical timeline centres on the network cabling installation, which is scheduled to end on Thursday 22 April 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Those working-day rules are noted here because they underpin the move-in arrangement described in the next paragraph. Rising removal costs could affect the budget.

The staff move-in can begin 5 working days after the network cabling installation ends. Mei Raman's communications workstream will be the channel through which staff hear about move-in arrangements, and Amara Kaur's logistics workstream covers the physical move itself. Zainab Esposito's badge work sits alongside both of those activities. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Later in the year, the security audit is on Wednesday 15 September 2027. The official opening of the new office is planned for Thursday 30 September 2027. Thandiwe Abernethy's lease negotiation workstream continues in parallel with the other activities, and each owner is expected to continue sending updates through the usual channels so that this briefing can be refreshed as new information arrives. A dispute over the lift installation could delay the official opening of the new office.

briefing:
The Tidewell flagship store launch is being run from the revised plan of Tuesday 26 January 2027, which supersedes all earlier emails. That plan sets the store opening for Thursday 19 August 2027. An earlier email of Wednesday 20 January 2027 had given the opening as Friday 10 September 2027, and that email is covered by the supersession.

On budget, the approved project budget is €574,000. In March the steering group approved a reduction of €18,000 to the project budget, and it also rejected a proposed further increase of €53,000. The shop-fitting contract is worth €25,500. A shortfall in seasonal stock could delay the store opening. The figure of €574,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Workstream ownership is as follows. Aisling Castellanos owns the shop fit-out workstream, and the fit-out is scheduled to end on Thursday 3 June 2027. Amara Brennan owns the stock buying workstream, and Elif Esposito supports it and attends its meetings. Tomasz Haddad owns the security workstream, with the security checkpoint on Monday 12 July 2027. Mei Raman owns the marketing campaign workstream, and the marketing campaign review is on Monday 9 August 2027. Higher rent from the service charge could affect the budget.

Staffing sits with Oluwaseun Nakamura, who owns the staff recruitment workstream. Svetlana Bakshi supports it and attends its meetings. The plan provides for 29 staff hires, and an additional 2 staff hires were approved in March. A request for 3 more staff hires is still awaiting approval. Rising wage costs could affect the number of staff hires.

Several activities depend on the fit-out. Stock loading can begin 8 working days after the shop fit-out ends. The point-of-sale systems kickoff can begin 8 working days after the shop fit-out sign-off is completed, and the kickoff is planned for Friday 30 July 2027. Working days are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Late delivery of the till system could delay the store opening. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

The remaining milestones are the stock count on Wednesday 18 August 2027 and the fire-safety inspection on Monday 30 August 2027. The press preview is on Friday 24 September 2027.

reference:
**Memo to: Lucía Takahashi, Programme Director**

**Summary**

The Tidewell flagship store launch is being run from the revised plan of Tuesday 26 January 2027, which supersedes all earlier emails, including the one of Wednesday 20 January 2027. The store opening is currently set for Thursday 19 August 2027. Two risks could delay the opening: a shortfall in seasonal stock, and late delivery of the till system.

**Key facts**

- Stock count: Wednesday 18 August 2027.
- Store opening: Thursday 19 August 2027.
- Staff recruitment workstream owner: Oluwaseun Nakamura.
- Stock buying workstream owner: Amara Brennan.
- Shop-fitting contract value: €25,500.
- Project budget after all approved changes: €556,000. This is the €574,000 first approved, less the €18,000 reduction approved in March. The proposed further increase of €53,000 was rejected.
- Marketing campaign review: Monday 9 August 2027, which is 20 working days after the security checkpoint on Monday 12 July 2027.
- Shop fit-out is scheduled to end on Thursday 3 June 2027. Stock loading can begin 8 working days later, so the earliest start is Tuesday 15 June 2027.
- The point-of-sale systems kickoff is planned for Friday 30 July 2027. It can begin 8 working days after shop fit-out sign-off, so the latest sign-off date that keeps this kickoff date is Tuesday 20 July 2027.

**Next steps**

Dated items and dependencies from the plan:

- Shop fit-out ends Thursday 3 June 2027.
- Stock loading can begin from Tuesday 15 June 2027.
- Security checkpoint: Monday 12 July 2027.
- Shop fit-out sign-off must be completed by Tuesday 20 July 2027 for the kickoff to go ahead.
- Point-of-sale systems kickoff: Friday 30 July 2027.
- Marketing campaign review: Monday 9 August 2027.
- Stock count: Wednesday 18 August 2027.
- Store opening: Thursday 19 August 2027.
- Fire-safety inspection: Monday 30 August 2027.
- Press preview: Friday 24 September 2027.
